subject: Booth emergency kit rebalance — split-shipment & reprint decision
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Booth sample consolidation — noticed color variance on polos

Jonas,

Quick heads-up from SwagCo: while QC'ing the polos for CloudConf booth kits they found a consistent color variance on the teal logo for lot #A7 (approx 250 units). Of those, 210 match our approved proof and 40 are ~2 shades darker. Vendor flagged that the darker batch fails our color tolerance.

Options from vendor: accept 210 and hold 40 for reprint (lead time 4 business days), reprint entire run (7 business days), or do an expedited 40-unit reprint (48 hours + overnight freight, higher cost). Venue delivery deadline is 2026-11-29 morning.

Attachments: design_proof_v3.pdf, vendor_quote_expedite.pdf

Can you confirm direction? If we split ship (send 210), we need approval from venue to accept partial deliveries and clear labeling. If we go full reprint we risk missing the on-site window.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: SwagCo Merch Ops <merchops@swagco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:05:12-08:00
Subject: RE: Booth sample consolidation — noticed color variance on polos

Hi Laura / Jonas / Grace,

Thanks for the quick heads-up. Confirming our findings: lot A7 has 210 units within spec and 40 units outside tolerance. Here are firm options with costs (see expedite_costs.xlsx):

1) Split ship: Ship 210 units on schedule (LTL, arrive by 11/29 AM), hold 40 units for reprint. No extra handling cost to ship partial, vendor will label "Partial — remaining to follow."

2) Expedited patch reprint (40 units): 48 hours production + next-day air to venue. Additional cost: $320 (production premium) + $160 overnight freight = $480 total.

3) Full reprint (250 units): 7 business days lead + standard freight. Estimated cost increase: $1,600.

We can execute option 2 immediately upon written approval and payment authorization. If you choose split ship (option 1) we will provide an itemized packing list and tracking for both shipments.

Attachment: expedite_costs.xlsx

Regards,
Maya Singh
Operations Manager, SwagCo
merchops@swagco.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, SwagCo Merch Ops <merchops@swagco.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Booth sample consolidation — noticed color variance on polos

Thanks for the clear options. Given the venue arrival constraint and cost sensitivity for this sponsorship: approve split shipment + expedited 40-unit patch reprint (option 1 + immediate option 2). Action items: 

- SwagCo: proceed with 210-unit LTL to arrive 11/29 AM and start 48-hour reprint for 40 units with overnight freight to venue. Please send invoice/PO instructions so procurement can approve charge to event_budget_2026.
- Laura: confirm with Moscone receiving that they will accept a labeled partial delivery and a follow-up overnight box; get receiving contact name and preferred instructions for "Partial Shipment — final arrivals" label.
- Grace: once packing details are confirmed, upload packing list and tracking to the CloudConf folder and ping CS for booth inventory reconciliation on site.

Marking this as time-sensitive — please confirm within 2 hours.

Jonas
VP, Field Marketing (acting)

From: Moscone Center Receiving <receiving@moscone.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: SwagCo Merch Ops <merchops@swagco.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Booth sample consolidation — noticed color variance on polos

Jonas / Laura,

We can accept split shipments for CloudConf. Please ensure the following on both shipments: 

1) Each carton labeled: "Redwood Inference — CloudConf Booth #B12 — Partial 1 of 2" and "Partial 2 of 2" for the reprint box.
2) Include a packing list in an external sleeve on each pallet/box.
3) Schedule LTL arrival window between 08:00–12:00 on 2026-11-29. Overnight box will be received at loading dock A and routed directly to the exhibitor services desk for immediate delivery to Booth B12.

If SwagCo provides tracking and the PO/invoice reference we will hold the goods and sign the delivery acceptance with the partial note.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Receiving Supervisor — Moscone Center
receiving@moscone.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: SwagCo Merch Ops <merchops@swagco.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Booth emergency kit rebalance — split-shipment & reprint decision

All set — thanks everyone. Laura, I'll draft the PO today and route to procurement with the expedite cost line item charged to event_budget_2026. SwagCo, please send final invoice and tracking as soon as you have it.

I uploaded the preliminary packing list to the event folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProofs (file: packing_list_cloudconf_v2.xlsx). I'll add the final packing list once SwagCo confirms cartonization.

Grace
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
